text:
Eli: quick heads up — did a focused a11y sweep on the new Model Activity table + header skiplink. Found a few keyboard/focus issues, logging here for prioritization.
Priya: thanks! summary bullets please, low-lift fixes first. :pray:
Eli: top-level notes: 1) Skip-to-panel link exists but it disappears from tab order after first use (likely due to focus handling), 2) Live region for streaming status is noisy for screen readers (reads every token change), 3) Row actions aren't reachable with arrow keys + Enter, only by tabbing to each button.
Jordan: can you paste repro steps and any quick CSS/js snippets? I can take the skiplink fix.
Eli: repro: open Console > Models > Model Activity. Tab until header; skiplink shows "Skip to table" but once activated it moves focus to table container and we set focus programmatically, then remove the element from DOM for animation. That removal kills subsequent keyboard access. Quick fix: keep skiplink in DOM, visually hide (`.sr-only--visible`) after activation but keep `tabindex=0`.
Sam: agree keep it in DOM. Also suggest adding `aria-controls="model-activity-table"` and `aria-describedby` to communicate target. For screen reader: avoid moving focus off the table header cell — instead focus the first interactive cell inside the table so users land on actionable controls.
Eli: live region details: streaming status element uses `aria-live="polite"` and updates every small change. NVDA/VoiceOver reads each tiny update. Proposed: debounce updates and only announce when line/row status transitions (idle->running->failed) and use `role="status"` with `aria-atomic="true"` for full message reads.
Priya: good catch. Are you proposing to batch token updates and suppress intermediate messages?
Sam: yes — for streaming we should never use `aria-live` for every token. Instead emit one status change summary. Example: `role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"` and only set text to e.g. "Model run 234: streaming started" then "Model run 234: complete, 37 tokens".
Jordan: noted. About row keyboard nav: current implementation relies on `tabindex=0` on buttons only. We should support row-level keyboard interaction: `role="row" tabindex="0"` and on Enter/Space open action menu, left/right to move cells. Sam — any advice on arrow key patterns?
Sam: pattern: when focus is on a row (`tabindex=0`), Left/Right should move logical cell focus using `aria-roledescription` for screen readers. Use `role="grid"` on container and `role="row"`/`role="gridcell"` for items to enable arrow navigation by default for AT. If we can't change to grid, implement JS handlers to move focus to next interactive cell and call `event.preventDefault()` on arrow keys. Add `aria-keyshortcuts` for common actions.
accessibility-bot: auto-audit: https://redwood-infra/audits/2245001234 — Contrast: PASS for 14/20 tokens, FAIL for 6 (secondary chip text on hover drops below 3:1). Focus visible: FAIL on compact table rows (outline: none).
Eli: contrast note — hover state for the status chips reduces contrast because background darkens but text stays same. Proposal: increase text weight or switch to white text on dark hover. I can prototype CSS: ```css .status-chip:hover { background-color: #2b2b2b; color: #ffffff; } ```
Priya: please include before/after screenshots in the PR. Also let's prioritize: 1) keep skiplink in DOM (Jordan) 2) debounce live region updates (Sam/Jordan) 3) row/keynav improvements (Jordan + Sam) 4) contrast fixes (Eli).
Jordan: I'll pick up 1-3 in a single PR with tests. Quick question — do we want to change the table to `role=grid`? That might affect existing AT expectations.
Sam: prefer incremental: JS arrow-handlers first to avoid large role changes. If we switch to `grid`, we need to audit every table semantics.
Eli: one more nit — focus indicator when opening the action flyout is hidden behind the modal overlay for ~150ms due to animation. Solution: set focus outline on trigger immediately before animation and persist until overlay takes focus.
Priya: great. Anything blocking? timeline?
Jordan: I'll aim for a draft PR by end of week, include unit tests for keyboard handlers and a11y smoke tests.
Sam: I can review and run NVDA/VO checks next Tue.
Eli: thanks all — linking this to the design backlog: https://redwood-infra/board/124 — will add notes. :white_check_mark:
